skill.displayName: Free 4K Video Upscaler – Upscale Video to 4K Online with AI – API-powered
skill.summary: Free 4K video upscaler — upscale video to 4K resolution using AI

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the free-4k-video-upscaler-openapi-skill.
- Enables free AI-powered upscaling of videos to 4K resolution via the WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports secure API key authentication (WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable).
- Includes endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Provides clear usage instructions and security guidelines for handling API keys.
